key_concepts: Reproduction is the production of new individuals from parents
Plants reproduce through sexual or asexual reproduction
Sexual reproduction produces new plants from seeds while asexual reproduction does not
A flower is the reproductive structure of flowering plants
Pollination is the transfer of pollen grains from anther to stigma
Wind, insects, birds, water, and animals are agents of pollination
Self-pollination transfers pollen within the same flower or plant
Cross-pollination transfers pollen between different plants of the same species
The pollen tube grows through the style to the ovary and fertilizes the egg cell
The fertilized ovule develops into a seed and the ovary becomes a fruit
Asexual reproduction produces offspring genetically identical to the parent plant
Natural and artificial vegetative reproduction are methods of asexual plant reproduction
